SELECT p.product_id, p.category_id, p.supplier_id, p.product_name, p.description, p.is_customizable, p.created_at, p.updated_at,
pr.min_price AS minPrice, pr.max_price AS maxPrice
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.product_id, MIN(sp.price) AS min_price, MAX(sp.price) AS max_price FROM sku s JOIN sku_price sp ON sp.sku_id = s.sku_id WHERE s.sku_id = ( SELECT MIN(s2.sku_id) FROM sku s2 WHERE s2.product_id = s.product_id ) GROUP BY s.product_id ) pr ON pr.product_id = p.product_id
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

SELECT p.product_id, p.category_id, p.supplier_id, p.product_name, p.description, p.is_customizable, p.created_at, p.updated_at, s.moq FROM products p LEFT JOIN sku s ON s.sku_id = ( SELECT MIN(s2.sku_id) FROM sku s2 WHERE s2.product_id = p.product_id )
WHERE p.product_id = #{productId}

SELECT p.product_id, p.category_id, p.product_name, p.description, p.is_customizable, p.created_at, p.updated_at, pr.min_price, pr.max_price FROM products p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.product_id, MIN(CAST(REPLACE(sp.price, ',', '') AS UNSIGNED)) AS min_price, MAX(CAST(REPLACE(sp.price, ',', '') AS UNSIGNED)) AS max_price FROM sku s JOIN sku_price sp ON sp.sku_id = s.sku_id WHERE s.sku_id = ( SELECT MIN(s2.sku_id) FROM sku s2 WHERE s2.product_id = s.product_id ) GROUP BY s.product_id ) pr ON pr.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.is_customizable = #{isCustomizable} ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
SELECT category_id, category_name FROM category WHERE parent_id IS NULL ORDER BY category_id

SELECT p.product_id, p.category_id, p.supplier_id, p.product_name, p.description, p.is_customizable, p.created_at, p.updated_at,
pr.min_price AS minPrice, pr.max_price AS maxPrice
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.product_id, MIN(sp.price) AS min_price, MAX(sp.price) AS max_price FROM sku s JOIN sku_price sp ON sp.sku_id = s.sku_id WHERE s.sku_id = ( SELECT MIN(s2.sku_id) FROM sku s2 WHERE s2.product_id = s.product_id ) GROUP BY s.product_id ) pr ON pr.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
